message:
Hi Naveed,

Our small nonprofit organization (<http://silverpine-studio.example|silverpine-studio.example>) is launching a YouTube channel, and we need a thumbnail for our first video. Ideally, it would be ready by the end of next week (thursday or friday). If you can help, I can send the video, a google doc containing thumbnail ideas and guidance, and one thumbnail I tried making myself. We would prefer the thumbnail not to contain AI-created assets, although minor AI-assisted edits such as generative fill in photoshop are probably okay. Would you be able to help?

Hi caleb,

I believe I can help with this. When you're available, let's discuss it in more detail. Please also share information about the channel and its content, along with the previous thumbnail you made yourself.

I've put the thumbnail ideas and guidance in this google doc:
<https://docs.google.example/document/d/silverpine-planning-brief-2048/edit?usp=sharing>

You can view the current cut of the video here:
<https://drive.google.example/file/d/silverpine-demo-reel-7315/view?usp=sharing>

I've also attached the thumbnail I made, though I think it's only okay.
The existing design can definitely be improved. Would delivery of the finished thumbnail within 72-96hrs work for you?
To help guide the design, could you send any competitors or examples that appeal to you? If there are brand guidelines I should follow, please share those too.
Please send over the title you currently have in mind for the video. I can provide additional title variations alongside yours so that we can run an A/B Test as well.

I have one question about the payment setup. Although I don't mind working hourly, watching the clock while I work can sometimes make it difficult to concentrate. If you're comfortable with the change, could we move to milestone-based fixed pricing instead?

Please share your thoughts so we can get started as soon as possible.
The offer has been modified to reflect that change!
I've included all of my preferences and reference ideas in the google doc. Would that document be enough for you?
caleb, I'll quickly review the document now.
It looks like I now have the video, ideas, examples, and your thoughts. One final question remains: should I extract your image from the video, or do you have separate headshot photos available?

Regarding your A/B Test suggestion, we are planning to use three titles for A/B testing:

Inside the automated newsroom linked to OpenAI’s super PAC.
Who bankrolls the bot reporters? Following OpenAI’s super PAC trail.
The hidden network behind an OpenAI-backed automated news site.
If that works for you, I'd prefer to take my image from the video itself.

That approach is possible, but I generally prefer separately taken headshots because they provide better image quality and give us more poses to work with. If that isn't possible, I can extract images from the video instead, and we can change the result if you don't like it.
Thank you, that sounds great! For future videos, we could potentially take more headshot-style photos.
For the current thumbnail, though, frame grabs from the current recording should work well.

For transparency, here is the section of Ai I may use. I do not use Ai for asset creation, though I might generate some elements or alter parts of photos with Generative Ai or other Ai's. Whatever is changed would be kept natural so it does not look made by Ai.
Sure
I'd prefer that you not use either of those methods—please don't generate new elements or alter parts of the photographs that way.
What we consider acceptable is limited AI editing, such as using photoshop's generative fill to remove a distracting prop from the background.
Newly generated assets and wholesale changes to the photograph are both things we would rather avoid.
Would it help build your confidence if I showed you some before-and-after image examples?
We won't use that approach if you don't want it.

You're welcome to share the examples, since I'm curious about your process. However, if it involves uploading images to ChatGPT/Gemini/Midjourney/etc. and asking the service to make changes, we would probably veto that approach.

Sorry about the restriction. Because we are an AI industry watchdog group, and many supporters worry about AI's impact on artists, we try not to use AI-generated assets or AI tools for coarse editing across an entire photo.
To be clear, I will not use Ai; instead, I'll photograph or manually create every original asset in photoshop.

Unfortunately, these examples appear to be wholesale AI content generation, even when existing photos are used as the starting point. We would prefer that this not be done; I hope that restriction works for you.

Caleb, understood. For wholesale content generation, I will not use AI; every complete asset will instead be made manually in Photoshop. AI will be limited to minimal use of Photoshop's Generative Fill for small touch-ups, never to generate full assets. Does that workflow work for you?
Thank you—that revised workflow works great.
Thank you, Caleb—perfect. I'm starting now and will deliver the thumbnail within 96hrs. Sounds good.

Hi Caleb,

A quick update: the concept is complete, and only the implementation remains. I'm experiencing a serious asthma flare-up and have been kept overnight for hospital monitoring. If I'm discharged next Monday, I'll send the final thumbnail variation by Monday evening; otherwise, it will arrive Tuesday morning for sure.

Once it's delivered, please send over any revision requests. I'm happy to continue refining it until you're fully satisfied with the result.

Best,
Naveed

Hi caleb,

I've completed five Concepts for you to review, and I also have a silhouette version in mind that I'll share shortly. In the meantime, please send your thoughts on these and let me know whether any revisions are required; I'm happy to help.

Hi Caleb,

Since I haven't yet received your thoughts on the existing thumbnail designs or any updated thumbnail details, I'm following up in case you missed my previous message. Please let me know your feedback or whether the requirements have changed so we can move forward.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Best,
Naveed

Hi Naveed,

I'm very sorry for the delayed response, and thank you for creating these. We ultimately selected a different thumbnail for the video, so we won't be using the submitted designs, but I appreciate your help. Because payment is late on our end, I'll pay next Friday and include a bonus.

Thanks again for all your help!

Caleb
